087  private static String getProperties(TunableConfig config) {
088    String properties = config == null ? "{}" : config.getProperties();
089    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(properties.length() + 32);
090    sb.append(properties, 0, properties.length() - 1);
091    if (sb.length() > 1) {
092      sb.append(',');
093    }
094    if (config != null && config.isRobust()) {
095      sb.append("\"robust\":true,");
096    }
097    sb.append("\"mutable\":").append(config == null || config.isMutable()).append(',');
098    sb.setCharAt(sb.length() - 1, '}');
099    return sb.toString();
100  }

102  private interface TunableEntry extends AutoCloseable {

104
105    @Override

107  }

109  private static boolean isAlwaysGet(TunableBase tunable) {
110    TunableConfig config = tunable.getConfig();
111    return config != null && config.getPolling() == TunableConfig.Polling.ALWAYS_GET;
112  }
113
114  private record InitialUpdate(Runnable callback) {}
115
116  private abstract class TunableValueEntry implements TunableEntry {
117    TunableValueEntry(String path, TunableBase tunable, TunableConfig config, String typeString) {
118      m_path = path;
119      m_tunable = tunable;
120      if (config != null && config.getTypeString() != null) {
121        typeString = config.getTypeString();
122      }
123      if (config != null && config.isRobust()) {
124        m_publisher =
125            m_inst.getTopic(path + "/value").genericPublishEx(typeString, getProperties(config));
126        m_subscriber =
127            m_inst
128                .getTopic(path + "/tune")
129                .genericSubscribe(typeString, PubSubOption.excludePublisher(m_publisher));
130      } else {
131        var topic = m_inst.getTopic(path);
132        m_publisher = topic.genericPublishEx(typeString, getProperties(config));
133        m_subscriber =
134            topic.genericSubscribe(typeString, PubSubOption.excludePublisher(m_publisher));
135      }
136      m_subscriberMap.put(m_subscriber.getHandle(), this);
137      if (config == null || config.isMutable()) {
138        boolean applyInitialValue = config != null && config.isRobust();
139        var eventKinds = EnumSet.of(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.VALUE_ALL);
140        if (applyInitialValue) {
141          eventKinds.add(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.IMMEDIATE);
142        }
143        m_listener = m_poller.addListener(m_subscriber, eventKinds);
144        if (applyInitialValue) {
145          // NT queues the initial snapshot atomically with listener registration.
146          // A separate subscriber read could apply a racing write twice.
147          for (var event : m_poller.readQueue()) {
148            if (event.listener == m_listener && event.is(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.IMMEDIATE)) {
149              // Immediate events include the topic's value even if the subscription
150              // is inactive because another type is already published.
151              if (event.valueData != null
152                  && typeString.equals(m_subscriber.getTopic().getTypeString())) {
153                m_initialValue = event.valueData.value;
154              }
155            } else {
156              m_pendingTuneEvents.add(event);
157            }
158          }
159        }
160      } else {
161        m_listener = 0;
162      }
163      m_onChange = config == null ? null : config.getOnTune();
164    }
165
166    @Override
167    public void close() {
168      if (m_listener != 0) {
169        m_poller.removeListener(m_listener);
170      }
171      m_subscriberMap.remove(m_subscriber.getHandle());
172      m_subscriber.close();
173      m_publisher.close();
174    }
175
176    @Override
177    public abstract void updateNetwork();
178
179    protected abstract boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value);
180
181    public Runnable updateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
182      if (!doUpdateTunable(value)) {
183        return null;
184      }
185      TunableRegistry.recordTuneApplied(m_tunable);
186      m_forcePublish = true;
187      return m_onChange;
188    }
189
190    public InitialUpdate updateInitialTunable() {
191      NetworkTableValue value = m_initialValue;
192      m_initialValue = null;
193      if (value == null || !value.isValid()) {
194        return null;
195      }
196      return new InitialUpdate(updateTunable(value));
197    }
198
199    protected boolean shouldPublishValue(boolean changed) {
200      boolean shouldPublish = m_forcePublish || changed;
201      m_forcePublish = false;
202      return shouldPublish;
203    }
204
205    protected void reportWarning(String msg) {
206      TunableRegistry.reportWarning("NetworkTables tunable '" + m_path + "': " + msg);
207    }
208
209    protected void reportWarning(String msg, Exception e) {
210      reportWarning(msg + ": " + e);
211    }
212
213    protected void reportNullValueRetained(String valueDescription, boolean hasPublishedValue) {
214      if (hasPublishedValue) {
215        reportWarning(
216            "null " + valueDescription + " value was not published; previous value retained");
217      }
218    }
219
220    protected final String m_path;
221    protected final GenericPublisher m_publisher;
222    protected final GenericSubscriber m_subscriber;
223    private final TunableBase m_tunable;
224    private final int m_listener;
225    private final Runnable m_onChange;
226    private NetworkTableValue m_initialValue;
227    private boolean m_forcePublish;
228  }

230  private final class TunableBooleanEntry extends TunableValueEntry {
231    TunableBooleanEntry(
232        String path,
233        TunableBase tunable,
234        TunableConfig config,
235        BooleanSupplier getter,
236        BooleanConsumer setter) {
237      super(path, tunable, config, "boolean");
238      m_getter = getter;
239      m_setter = setter;
240      updateNetwork();
241    }
242
243    @Override
244    public void updateNetwork() {
245      boolean value = m_getter.getAsBoolean();
246      if (shouldPublishValue(!m_hasLastValue || value != m_lastValue)) {
247        m_lastValue = value;
248        m_hasLastValue = true;
249        m_publisher.setBoolean(value);
250      }
251    }
252
253    @Override
254    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
255      m_setter.accept(value.getBoolean());
256      return true;
257    }
258
259    private final BooleanSupplier m_getter;
260    private final BooleanConsumer m_setter;
261    private boolean m_lastValue;
262    private boolean m_hasLastValue;
263  }

405  @FunctionalInterface
406  private interface ValuePublisher<T> {
407    void publish(GenericPublisher publisher, T value);
408  }
409
410  @FunctionalInterface
411  private interface ValueReader<T> {
412    T read(NetworkTableValue value);
413  }
414
415  private final class NullableTunableValueEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
416    NullableTunableValueEntry(
417        String path,
418        Tunable<T> tunable,
419        String typeString,
420        ValuePublisher<T> valuePublisher,
421        ValueReader<T> valueReader) {
422      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), typeString);
423      m_tunables = tunable;
424      m_valueDescription = typeString;
425      m_valuePublisher = valuePublisher;
426      m_valueReader = valueReader;
427      updateNetwork();
428    }
429
430    @Override
431    public void updateNetwork() {
432      T value = m_tunables.get();
433      if (value == null) {
434        shouldPublishValue(false);
435        reportNullValueRetained(m_valueDescription, m_hasLastValue);
436      } else if (shouldPublishValue(!m_hasLastValue || !value.equals(m_lastValue))) {
437        m_lastValue = value;
438        m_hasLastValue = true;
439        m_valuePublisher.publish(m_publisher, value);
440      }
441    }
442
443    @Override
444    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
445      m_tunables.set(m_valueReader.read(value));
446      return true;
447    }
448
449    private final Tunable<T> m_tunables;
450    private final String m_valueDescription;
451    private final ValuePublisher<T> m_valuePublisher;
452    private final ValueReader<T> m_valueReader;
453    private T m_lastValue;
454    private boolean m_hasLastValue;
455  }

458    TunableRawEntry(String path, Tunable<byte[]> tunable) {
459      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), "raw");
460      m_tunables = tunable;
461      updateNetwork();
462    }
463
464    @Override
465    public void updateNetwork() {
466      byte[] value = m_tunables.get();
467      if (value == null) {
468        shouldPublishValue(false);
469        reportNullValueRetained("raw", m_lastValue != null);
470        return;
471      }
472      if (shouldPublishValue(!Arrays.equals(value, m_lastValue))) {
473        m_lastValue = Arrays.copyOf(value, value.length);
474        m_publisher.setRaw(value, 0, value.length);
475      }
476    }
477
478    @Override
479    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
480      m_tunables.set(value.getRaw());
481      return true;
482    }
483
484    private final Tunable<byte[]> m_tunables;
485    private byte[] m_lastValue;
486  }

519  private final class TunableIntArrayEntry extends TunableValueEntry {
520    TunableIntArrayEntry(String path, Tunable<int[]> tunable) {
521      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), "int[]");
522      m_tunables = tunable;
523      updateNetwork();
524    }
525
526    @Override
527    public void updateNetwork() {
528      int[] value = m_tunables.get();
529      if (value == null) {
530        shouldPublishValue(false);
531        reportNullValueRetained("int array", m_lastValue != null);
532        return;
533      }
534      if (shouldPublishValue(!Arrays.equals(value, m_lastValue))) {
535        m_lastValue = Arrays.copyOf(value, value.length);
536        m_publisher.setIntegerArray(toLongArray(value));
537      }
538    }
539
540    @Override
541    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
542      m_tunables.set(fromLongArray(value.getIntegerArray()));
543      return true;
544    }
545
546    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidArrayLoops")
547    private static long[] toLongArray(int[] arr) {
548      long[] result = new long[arr.length];
549      for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
550        result[i] = arr[i];
551      }
552      return result;
553    }
554
555    private static int[] fromLongArray(long[] arr) {
556      int[] result = new int[arr.length];
557      for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
558        result[i] = (int) arr[i];
559      }
560      return result;
561    }
562
563    private int[] m_lastValue;
564    private final Tunable<int[]> m_tunables;
565  }

691  private final class TunableStructEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
692    TunableStructEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableStruct<T> tunable) {
693      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getStruct().getTypeString());
694      m_tunables = tunable;
695      m_buf = StructBuffer.create(tunable.getStruct());
696      updateNetwork();
697    }
698
699    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
700    @Override
701    public void updateNetwork() {
702      T value = m_tunables.get();
703      try {
704        synchronized (m_buf) {
705          if (!m_schemaPublished) {
706            m_publisher.getTopic().getInstance().addSchema(m_buf.getStruct());
707            m_schemaPublished = true;
708          }
709          if (value == null) {
710            m_publisher.setRaw(new byte[0], 0, 0);
711          } else {
712            ByteBuffer bb = m_buf.write(value);
713            m_publisher.setRaw(bb, 0, bb.position());
714          }
715        }
716      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
717        reportWarning("failed to publish struct value", e);
718      }
719    }
720
721    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
722    @Override
723    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
724      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
725      if (data.length == 0) {
726        m_tunables.set(null);
727        return true;
728      }
729      if (data.length != m_buf.getStruct().getSize()) {
730        reportWarning(
731            "rejected struct tune payload with "
732                + data.length
733                + " bytes; expected "
734                + m_buf.getStruct().getSize());
735        return false;
736      }
737      T tunedValue;
738      try {
739        synchronized (m_buf) {
740          tunedValue = m_buf.read(data);
741        }
742      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
743        reportWarning("rejected struct tune payload", e);
744        return false;
745      }
746      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);
747      return true;
748    }
749
750    private final Tunable.TunableStruct<T> m_tunables;
751    private final StructBuffer<T> m_buf;
752    private boolean m_schemaPublished;
753  }
754
755  private final class TunableStructArrayEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
756    TunableStructArrayEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableStructArray<T> tunable) {
757      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getStruct().getTypeString() + "[]");
758      m_tunables = tunable;
759      m_buf = StructBuffer.create(tunable.getStruct());
760      updateNetwork();
761    }
762
763    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
764    @Override
765    public void updateNetwork() {
766      T[] value = m_tunables.get();
767      if (value == null) {
768        if (m_hasPublishedValue) {
769          reportWarning("null struct array value was not published; previous value retained");
770        }
771        return;
772      }
773      try {
774        synchronized (m_buf) {
775          if (!m_schemaPublished) {
776            m_publisher.getTopic().getInstance().addSchema(m_buf.getStruct());
777            m_schemaPublished = true;
778          }
779          ByteBuffer bb = m_buf.writeArray(value);
780          m_publisher.setRaw(bb, 0, bb.position());
781          m_hasPublishedValue = true;
782        }
783      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
784        reportWarning("failed to publish struct array value", e);
785      }
786    }
787
788    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
789    @Override
790    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
791      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
792      int size = m_buf.getStruct().getSize();
793      if (size == 0 || data.length % size != 0) {
794        reportWarning(
795            "rejected struct array tune payload with "
796                + data.length
797                + " bytes; expected a multiple of "
798                + size);
799        return false;
800      }
801      T[] tunedValue;
802      try {
803        synchronized (m_buf) {
804          tunedValue = m_buf.readArray(data);
805        }
806      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
807        reportWarning("rejected struct array tune payload", e);
808        return false;
809      }
810      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);
811      return true;
812    }
813
814    private final Tunable.TunableStructArray<T> m_tunables;
815    private final StructBuffer<T> m_buf;
816    private boolean m_schemaPublished;
817    private boolean m_hasPublishedValue;
818  }
819
820  private final class TunableProtobufEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
821    TunableProtobufEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableProtobuf<T> tunable) {
822      super(path, tunable, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getProtobuf().getTypeString());
823      m_tunables = tunable;

826    }
827
828    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
829    @Override
830    public void updateNetwork() {
831      T value = m_tunables.get();
832      if (value == null) {
833        if (m_hasPublishedValue) {
834          reportWarning("null protobuf value was not published; previous value retained");
835        }
836        return;
837      }
838      try {
839        synchronized (m_buf) {
840          if (!m_schemaPublished) {

853    }
854
855    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
856    @Override
857    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
858      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
859      T tunedValue;
860      try {
861        synchronized (m_buf) {
862          tunedValue = m_buf.read(data);
863        }
864      } catch (IOException e) {
865        reportWarning("rejected protobuf tune payload", e);
866        return false;
867      } catch (RuntimeException e) {

870      }
871      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);

873    }

875    private final Tunable.TunableProtobuf<T> m_tunables;

877    private boolean m_schemaPublished;

910  /**
911   * Construct.
912   *
913   * @param inst NetworkTables instance
914   * @param prefix prefix to put in front of tunable paths in NT
915   */
916  public NetworkTablesTunableBackend(NetworkTableInstance inst, String prefix) {
917    m_inst = inst;
918    m_prefix = prefix;
919    m_poller = new NetworkTableListenerPoller(inst);
920  }
921
922  private boolean hasActiveEntry(String path) {
923    StoredEntry entry = m_entries.get(path);
924    return entry != null && !entry.closed;
925  }
926
927  private boolean hasQueuedActiveEntry(String path) {
928    if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
929      Boolean pendingState = m_pendingPathStates.get(path);
930      if (pendingState != null) {
931        return pendingState;
932      }
933    }
934    return hasActiveEntry(path);
935  }
936
937  private void trackEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
938    if (entry.tunable == null) {
939      m_complexEntries.add(entry);
940      return;
941    }
942
943    if (isAlwaysGet(entry.tunable)) {
944      m_alwaysGetEntries.add(entry);
945    } else if (entry.tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
946      m_entriesByTunable.computeIfAbsent(entry.tunable, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(entry);
947      if (entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
948        enqueueDirtyEntry(entry);
949      }
950    } else {
951      m_polledEntries.add(entry);
952    }
953  }
954
955  private void untrackEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
956    m_dirtyEntries.remove(entry);
957    entry.dirtyQueued = false;
958
959    if (entry.tunable == null) {
960      m_complexEntries.remove(entry);
961      return;
962    }
963
964    if (isAlwaysGet(entry.tunable)) {
965      m_alwaysGetEntries.remove(entry);
966    } else if (entry.tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
967      List<StoredEntry> entries = m_entriesByTunable.get(entry.tunable);
968      if (entries != null) {
969        entries.remove(entry);
970        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
971          m_entriesByTunable.remove(entry.tunable);
972        }
973      }
974    } else {
975      m_polledEntries.remove(entry);
976    }
977  }
978
979  private void clearTrackedEntries() {
980    m_entries.clear();
981    m_entriesByTunable.clear();
982    m_dirtyEntries.clear();
983    m_alwaysGetEntries.clear();
984    m_complexEntries.clear();
985    m_polledEntries.clear();
986  }
987
988  private void enqueueDirtyEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
989    if (!entry.closed && !entry.dirtyQueued) {
990      entry.dirtyQueued = true;
991      m_dirtyEntries.add(entry);
992    }
993  }
994
995  private void closeEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
996    if (entry.closed) {
997      return;
998    }
999    entry.closed = true;
1000    entry.entry.close();
1001    if (m_updateDepth == 0) {
1002      untrackEntry(entry);
1003    }
1004  }
1005
1006  private void eraseEntry(String path, StoredEntry entry) {
1007    if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1008      m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1009      m_pendingMutations.add(() -> eraseEntryNow(path, entry));
1010    } else {
1011      eraseEntryNow(path, entry);
1012    }
1013  }
1014
1015  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
1016  private void eraseEntryNow(String path, StoredEntry entry) {
1017    if (m_entries.get(path) == entry) {
1018      m_entries.remove(path);
1019      untrackEntry(entry);
1020    }
1021  }
1022
1023  private void applyPendingMutations() {
1024    try {
1025      while (!m_pendingMutations.isEmpty()) {
1026        List<Runnable> mutations = new ArrayList<>(m_pendingMutations);
1027        m_pendingMutations.clear();
1028        for (Runnable mutation : mutations) {
1029          mutation.run();
1030        }
1031      }
1032    } finally {
1033      m_pendingPathStates.clear();
1034    }
1035  }
1036
1037  @Override
1038  public void close() {
1039    synchronized (m_entries) {
1040      if (m_closed) {
1041        return;
1042      }
1043      m_closed = true;
1044      m_pendingMutations.clear();
1045      m_pendingPathStates.clear();
1046      for (StoredEntry entry : m_entries.values()) {
1047        closeEntry(entry);
1048      }
1049      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1050        m_pendingMutations.add(this::clearTrackedEntries);
1051      } else {
1052        clearTrackedEntries();
1053      }
1054      m_subscriberMap.clear();
1055      m_pendingTuneEvents.clear();
1056      m_poller.close();
1057    }
1058  }
1059
1060  @Override
1061  public boolean publish(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
1062    InitialUpdate initialUpdate;
1063    synchronized (m_entries) {
1064      if (m_closed) {
1065        return false;
1066      }
1067      if (hasQueuedActiveEntry(path)) {
1068        TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1069            "NetworkTables tunable '" + m_prefix + path + "' already exists");
1070        return false;
1071      }
1072      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1073        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, true);
1074        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> publish(path, tunable));
1075        return true;
1076      }
1077      String ntPath = m_prefix + path;
1078      TunableValueEntry entry;
1079      switch (tunable) {
1080        case TunableBoolean v -> entry = new TunableBooleanEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1081        case TunableInt v -> entry = new TunableIntEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1082        case TunableLong v -> entry = new TunableLongEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1083        case TunableFloat v -> entry = new TunableFloatEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1084        case TunableDouble v -> entry = new TunableDoubleEntry(ntPath, v, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1085        case Tunable.TunableStruct<?> v -> entry = new TunableStructEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1086        case Tunable.TunableStructArray<?> v -> entry = new TunableStructArrayEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1087        case Tunable.TunableProtobuf<?> v -> entry = new TunableProtobufEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1088        case Tunable<?> t -> {
1089          Class<?> cls = t.getTypeClass();
1090          if (cls == null) {
1091            TunableRegistry.reportWarning("Tunable type <null> is not supported by NetworkTables");
1092            return false;
1093          }
1094          switch (cls) {
1095            case Class<?> c when c == String.class -> {
1096              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1097              Tunable<String> tt = (Tunable<String>) t;
1098              entry =
1099                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1100                      ntPath,
1101                      tt,
1102                      "string",
1103                      GenericPublisher::setString,
1104                      NetworkTableValue::getString);
1105            }
1106            case Class<?> c when c == byte[].class -> {
1107              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1108              Tunable<byte[]> tt = (Tunable<byte[]>) t;
1109              entry = new TunableRawEntry(ntPath, tt);
1110            }
1111            case Class<?> c when c == boolean[].class -> {
1112              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1113              Tunable<boolean[]> tt = (Tunable<boolean[]>) t;
1114              entry = new TunableBooleanArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1115            }
1116            case Class<?> c when c == int[].class -> {
1117              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1118              Tunable<int[]> tt = (Tunable<int[]>) t;
1119              entry = new TunableIntArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1120            }
1121            case Class<?> c when c == long[].class -> {
1122              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1123              Tunable<long[]> tt = (Tunable<long[]>) t;
1124              entry = new TunableLongArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1125            }
1126            case Class<?> c when c == float[].class -> {
1127              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1128              Tunable<float[]> tt = (Tunable<float[]>) t;
1129              entry = new TunableFloatArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1130            }
1131            case Class<?> c when c == double[].class -> {
1132              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1133              Tunable<double[]> tt = (Tunable<double[]>) t;
1134              entry = new TunableDoubleArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1135            }
1136            case Class<?> c when c == String[].class -> {
1137              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1138              Tunable<String[]> tt = (Tunable<String[]>) t;
1139              entry = new TunableStringArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1140            }
1141            case Class<?> c when c == Boolean.class -> {
1142              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1143              Tunable<Boolean> tt = (Tunable<Boolean>) t;
1144              entry =
1145                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1146                      ntPath,
1147                      tt,
1148                      "boolean",
1149                      GenericPublisher::setBoolean,
1150                      NetworkTableValue::getBoolean);
1151            }
1152            case Class<?> c when c == Integer.class -> {
1153              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1154              Tunable<Integer> tt = (Tunable<Integer>) t;
1155              entry =
1156                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1157                      ntPath,
1158                      tt,
1159                      "int",
1160                      GenericPublisher::setInteger,
1161                      value -> (int) value.getInteger());
1162            }
1163            case Class<?> c when c == Long.class -> {
1164              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1165              Tunable<Long> tt = (Tunable<Long>) t;
1166              entry =
1167                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1168                      ntPath,
1169                      tt,
1170                      "int",
1171                      GenericPublisher::setInteger,
1172                      NetworkTableValue::getInteger);
1173            }
1174            case Class<?> c when c == Float.class -> {
1175              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1176              Tunable<Float> tt = (Tunable<Float>) t;
1177              entry =
1178                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1179                      ntPath, tt, "float", GenericPublisher::setFloat, NetworkTableValue::getFloat);
1180            }
1181            case Class<?> c when c == Double.class -> {
1182              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1183              Tunable<Double> tt = (Tunable<Double>) t;
1184              entry =
1185                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1186                      ntPath,
1187                      tt,
1188                      "double",
1189                      GenericPublisher::setDouble,
1190                      NetworkTableValue::getDouble);
1191            }
1192            default -> {
1193              TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1194                  "Tunable type "
1195                      + t.getTypeClass().getName()
1196                      + " is not supported by NetworkTables");
1197              return false;
1198            }
1199          }
1200        }
1201        default -> {
1202          TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1203              "Tunable implementation "
1204                  + tunable.getClass().getName()
1205                  + " is not supported by NetworkTables");
1206          return false;
1207        }
1208      }
1209      StoredEntry storedEntry = new StoredEntry(entry, tunable, null);
1210      m_entries.put(path, storedEntry);
1211      trackEntry(storedEntry);
1212      initialUpdate = entry.updateInitialTunable();
1213      if (initialUpdate != null) {
1214        entry.updateNetwork();
1215      }
1216    }
1217
1218    if (initialUpdate != null && initialUpdate.callback() != null) {
1219      TunableRegistry.runAfterUpdate(initialUpdate.callback());
1220    }
1221    return true;
1222  }
1223
1224  @Override
1225  public boolean publishComplex(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
1226    synchronized (m_entries) {
1227      if (m_closed) {
1228        return false;
1229      }
1230      if (hasQueuedActiveEntry(path)) {
1231        TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1232            "NetworkTables tunable '" + m_prefix + path + "' already exists");
1233        return false;
1234      }
1235      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1236        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, true);
1237        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> publishComplex(path, tunable));
1238        return true;
1239      }
1240      StoredEntry storedEntry =
1241          new StoredEntry(new ComplexTunableEntry(m_prefix + path, tunable), null, tunable);
1242      m_entries.put(path, storedEntry);
1243      trackEntry(storedEntry);
1244    }
1245
1246    TunableRegistry.publishComplexChildren(path, tunable);
1247    return true;
1248  }
1249
1250  @Override
1251  public void remove(String path) {
1252    synchronized (m_entries) {
1253      if (m_closed) {
1254        return;
1255      }
1256      StoredEntry entry = m_entries.get(path);
1257      if (entry != null && !entry.closed) {
1258        closeEntry(entry);
1259        eraseEntry(path, entry);
1260      } else if (m_updateDepth > 0 && Boolean.TRUE.equals(m_pendingPathStates.get(path))) {
1261        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1262        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> remove(path));
1263      }
1264    }
1265  }
1266
1267  @Override
1268  public List<PublishedTunable> removePrefix(String prefix) {
1269    String normalizedPrefix = PathUtil.normalizePrefix(prefix);
1270    List<PublishedTunable> removed = new ArrayList<>();
1271    synchronized (m_entries) {
1272      var iterator = m_entries.entrySet().iterator();
1273      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
1274        var mapEntry = iterator.next();
1275        if (!PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(mapEntry.getKey(), normalizedPrefix)) {
1276          continue;
1277        }
1278        StoredEntry entry = mapEntry.getValue();
1279        if (entry.closed) {
1280          continue;
1281        }
1282        removed.add(new PublishedTunable(mapEntry.getKey(), entry.tunable, entry.complex));
1283        closeEntry(entry);
1284        if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1285          String path = mapEntry.getKey();
1286          m_pendingMutations.add(() -> eraseEntryNow(path, entry));
1287        } else {
1288          iterator.remove();
1289        }
1290      }
1291      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1292        List<String> pendingRemoves = new ArrayList<>();
1293        for (var pendingEntry : m_pendingPathStates.entrySet()) {
1294          if (pendingEntry.getValue()
1295              && PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(pendingEntry.getKey(), normalizedPrefix)) {
1296            pendingRemoves.add(pendingEntry.getKey());
1297          }
1298        }
1299        for (String path : pendingRemoves) {
1300          m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1301          m_pendingMutations.add(() -> remove(path));
1302        }
1303      }
1304    }
1305    return removed;
1306  }
1307
1308  @Override
1309  public void markDirty(TunableBase tunable) {
1310    synchronized (m_entries) {
1311      if (m_closed || isAlwaysGet(tunable) || !tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
1312        return;
1313      }
1314      List<StoredEntry> entries = m_entriesByTunable.get(tunable);
1315      if (entries == null) {
1316        return;
1317      }
1318      for (StoredEntry entry : entries) {
1319        enqueueDirtyEntry(entry);
1320      }
1321    }
1322  }
1323
1324  private void updateComplexEntries() {
1325    try {
1326      m_updatedComplexEntries.clear();
1327      for (StoredEntry entry : m_complexEntries) {
1328        if (!entry.closed && m_updatedComplexEntries.put(entry.complex, Boolean.TRUE) == null) {
1329          entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1330        }
1331      }
1332    } finally {
1333      m_updatedComplexEntries.clear();
1334    }
1335  }
1336
1337  private void updateAlwaysGetEntries() {
1338    for (StoredEntry entry : m_alwaysGetEntries) {
1339      if (!entry.closed) {
1340        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1341        if (entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1342          TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1343        }
1344      }
1345    }
1346  }
1347
1348  private void updatePolledEntries() {
1349    for (StoredEntry entry : m_polledEntries) {
1350      if (!entry.closed && entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1351        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1352        TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1353      }
1354    }
1355  }
1356
1357  private void updateDirtyEntries() {
1358    for (StoredEntry entry : m_dirtyEntries) {
1359      entry.dirtyQueued = false;
1360      if (!entry.closed && entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1361        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1362        TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1363      }
1364    }
1365    m_dirtyEntries.clear();
1366  }
1367
1368  private void processTuneEvent(NetworkTableEvent event, List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1369    if (event.valueData == null || event.valueData.value == null) {
1370      return;
1371    }
1372    TunableValueEntry entry = m_subscriberMap.get(event.valueData.subentry);
1373    if (entry == null) {
1374      return;
1375    }
1376    Runnable callback = entry.updateTunable(event.valueData.value);
1377    if (callback == null) {
1378      return;
1379    }
1380    onChangeCallbacks.add(callback);
1381  }
1382
1383  private void processTuneEvents(NetworkTableEvent[] events, List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1384    for (NetworkTableEvent event : events) {
1385      processTuneEvent(event, onChangeCallbacks);
1386    }
1387  }
1388
1389  private void scheduleOnChangeCallbacks(List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1390    for (Runnable callback : onChangeCallbacks) {
1391      TunableRegistry.runAfterUpdate(callback);
1392    }
1393  }
1394
1395  private List<Runnable> acquireOnChangeCallbacks() {
1396    if (m_usingOnChangeCallbacks) {
1397      return new ArrayList<>();
1398    }
1399    m_usingOnChangeCallbacks = true;
1400    m_onChangeCallbacks.clear();
1401    return m_onChangeCallbacks;
1402  }
1403
1404  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
1405  private void releaseOnChangeCallbacks(List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1406    onChangeCallbacks.clear();
1407    synchronized (m_entries) {
1408      if (onChangeCallbacks == m_onChangeCallbacks) {
1409        m_usingOnChangeCallbacks = false;
1410      }
1411    }
1412  }
1413
1414  @Override
1415  public void update() {
1416    List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks;
1417    synchronized (m_entries) {
1418      onChangeCallbacks = acquireOnChangeCallbacks();
1419    }
1420    try {
1421      synchronized (m_entries) {
1422        if (m_closed) {
1423          return;
1424        }
1425        // update tunables from network changes
1426        var pendingEvents = m_pendingTuneEvents.toArray(NetworkTableEvent[]::new);
1427        m_pendingTuneEvents.clear();
1428        var events = m_poller.readQueue();
1429        processTuneEvents(pendingEvents, onChangeCallbacks);
1430        processTuneEvents(events, onChangeCallbacks);
1431
1432        // update network from tunable changes
1433        // updateNetwork() can run user getters or complex update code that re-enters this backend.
1434        m_updateDepth++;
1435        try {
1436          updateComplexEntries();
1437          updateAlwaysGetEntries();
1438          updatePolledEntries();
1439          updateDirtyEntries();
1440        } finally {
1441          m_updateDepth--;
1442          if (m_updateDepth == 0) {
1443            applyPendingMutations();
1444          }
1445        }
1446      }
1447
1448      // onTune callbacks can publish or remove tunables, so run them without the backend lock held.
1449      scheduleOnChangeCallbacks(onChangeCallbacks);
1450    } finally {
1451      releaseOnChangeCallbacks(onChangeCallbacks);
1452    }
1453  }
1454}
